bounded_host_request.command:
python3 -c 'import os,subprocess,json,http.client
from pathlib import Path
rows=subprocess.check_output(["ps","-eo","pid,args"],text=True).splitlines()
pids=[f[0] for r in rows if len(f:=r.strip().split(None,1))==2 and f[1].startswith("python3 /home/admin1/projects/ai-core/") and "--serve --exclusive-traffic" in f[1]]
assert len(pids)==1,"GATE_PROCESS_NOT_UNIQUE"
v=Path("/proc/"+pids[0]+"/environ").read_bytes().split(b"\0")
env=dict(x.split(b"=",1) for x in v if b"=" in x)
keys=[x for k,x in env.items() if k.endswith(b"_API_KEY") and len(x)>=16]
assert len(keys)==1,"GATE_CREDENTIAL_NOT_IDENTIFIED"
h={"Authorization":"Bearer "+keys[0].decode()}
c=http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1",18184,timeout=140)
c.request("GET","/v1/models",headers=h);r=c.getresponse();models=json.loads(r.read());assert r.status==200,(r.status,models)
m=models["data"][0]["id"]
body=json.dumps({"model":m,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Reply OK"}],"max_tokens":2,"stream":False})
c.request("POST","/v1/chat/completions",body=body,headers={**h,"Content-Type":"application/json"})
r=c.getresponse();b=r.read(262144);print("AI_CORE_POST",r.status,"JSON",b[:1]==b"{","LENGTH",len(b))
assert r.status==200
c.close()'
